text:
EMSA Academy delivers first course on hydrogen
The EMSA Academy has delivered the first course on hydrogen, as part of its “Alternative Fuels” learning package.
The course was designed in a blended-learning format, combining asynchronous learning materials available on MaKCs, the Academy’s e-learning platform, with two live online sessions.
The course aimed to provide professionals working in maritime administrations with the knowledge and skills required to understand and facilitate the safe and effective adoption of hydrogen as an alternative marine fuel.
This short course is complemented by the EMSA Academy’s Tide Talks webinar on Hydrogen, which will be streamed online on 29th June, and is open to all.
